quantity: flight-stage PAS_BRD, ST_PAS, CAF_PAS; both directions, all carriers; counterpart reporters averaged

inputs.role: fixed coordinates for descriptive great-circle distance, never current airport activity

policy.main_cohort: One fixed airport-pair cohort with 12 clean months in 2015, 2019 and 2024, using the identical reporting-airport intersection across all three years.
policy.quality: All monthly triplets finite/nonnegative; source flags rejected; passengers cannot exceed seats; positive traffic/capacity requires flights; no monthly counterpart disagreement >10% in selected years. All-zero months are allowed, annual totals must be positive.
policy.no_fill: Missing months are not zeros. No interpolation or inferred closures.
policy.selection: Retrospective endpoint-balanced routes; excludes unobserved entrants, exits and incomplete routes. Not total Europe or causal fleet demand.
policy.same_reporters: One identical reporting-airport set throughout all selected years; counterpart observations never summed.
policy.lmdi: For P0,P1 >0: contribution_k = (P1-P0)/ln(P1/P0) * ln(factor1_k/factor0_k); equal P uses limit P0.
policy.aggregate_caveat: Aggregate seats/flight includes route mix within the fixed cohort. Median paired changes and summed within-pair LMDI are provided separately.
policy.capacity_groups: Assigned by observed mean seats/flight in 2015; no reassignment using future outcomes.
policy.distance: Great-circle distance from pinned route-research airport coordinates; not payload-range feasibility or current routing.
policy.types: Average seats/flight does not identify an aircraft type, seating configuration or carrier. No airline profitability claim follows.
